title: Exam FRQ: the toll booth
prompt:
45-minute FRQ section. Implement the `TollBooth` class:

- constructor takes the toll amount (int cents)
- `pay(int paid)` records a payment; returns the change due (paid - toll, floored at 0)
- `shortfall(int paid)` returns toll - paid when paid is less than toll, else 0
- `totalCollected()` returns the sum of ALL toll amounts actually collected (min(paid, toll) per payment; reset by `endDay()`)
- `endDay()` returns the day's total and resets it

Implement the full class.

tests.name: toll booth frq
tests.hint: pay returns max(0, paid - toll); shortfall max(0, toll - paid); collect min(paid, toll); endDay reads-and-resets.
